reviews.text: Great range of products and staff very helpful

The staff are extremely helpful and knowledgeable, I availed of the home delivery service during the week due to poor health on my part ,its great to support this business as my 2 dogs have skin allergies and are doing well on the dog food recommended by the staff.
Excellant staff, everything you need for your pet at great prices 🐕🐈‍⬛🐭 …
Large petshop,very well stocked and always friendly staff.Plenty of parking outside.
Very friendly and professional service. If they don't have something in stock, they'll order it for you. A quick and pleasant shopping experience. Highly recommended.

The lady who owns and works here is such a sweetheart. The staff is helpful and knowledgeable and all items reasonably priced. I love the huge selection they have. They truly care about your animal too. They really took the time to help me find the best dog collar after my pup was healing from a bad wound and needed something just right. Will be a repeat customer! 🤗🤗
A well-stocked shop. Importantly, there's always plenty of parking.
Great shop with a variety of everything and Very helpful staff.
The girls were very helpful as always
Very helpful and friendly staff always 😊 …
Everything you need for your pet, it's their anniversary today, and every year there is a 20%off great sale. Family run business very helpful

Great selection of dog food and treats. Staff are always happy to help. Had a fault with a dog collar (clip broke after 4 weeks).  Owner was very helpful and they were happy to replace it and contact the supplier.
